short_en: D.R. Horton, Inc. is the largest homebuilding company in the United States as measured by number of homes closed. We construct and sell homes through our operating divisions in 126 markets across 36 states. Our common stock is included in the S&P 500 Index and listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) and NYSE Texas under the ticker symbol “DHI.” Our listing on NYSE Texas became effective in June 2025.
full_en: D.R. Horton, Inc. is the largest homebuilding company in the United States as measured by number of homes closed. We construct and sell homes through our operating divisions in 126 markets across 36 states. Our common stock is included in the S&P 500 Index and listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) and NYSE Texas under the ticker symbol “DHI.” Our listing on NYSE Texas became effective in June 2025. Unless the context otherwise requires, the terms “D.R. Horton,” the “Company,” “we” and “our” used herein refer to D.R. Horton, Inc., a Delaware corporation, and its predecessors and subsidiaries. Our homebuilding business began in 1978 in Fort Worth, Texas, and our common stock has been publicly traded since 1992. We have expanded and diversified our homebuilding operations geographically over the years by investing capital and building teams of people in our existing markets, starting new operations in additional markets and acquiring other homebuilding companies. We have closed more than 1.2 million homes during our 47-year history, and we have been the largest volume homebuilder in the United States every year since 2002.

Horton", "Company", "We" ו-"שלנו" המשמשים כאן ב-D.R. Horton, Inc., תאגיד דלאוור, וקודמיו וחברות הבת שלה. עסקי בניית הבתים שלנו החלו בשנת 1978 בפורט וורת', טקסס, והמניה המשותפת שלנו נסחרת בפומבי מאז 1992. הרחבנו ומגדילנו את פעולות בניית הבתים שלנו מבחינה גיאוגרפית לאורך השנים על ידי השקעה בבניית קבוצות של אנשים בשווקים הקיימים שלנו, החל פעולות חדשות בשווקים נוספים ורכישת חברות אחרות לבניית בתים. סגרנו יותר מ-1.2 מיליון בתים במהלך ההיסטוריה בת ה-47 שנה, והיינו בעלי הבית הגדולים ביותר בארצות הברית בכל שנה מאז 2002.
